usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve the certificate directory index for a specific PDM node, which lists the certificate-related sub-resources available (e.g. custom, info). No query parameters are required and any authenticated user may call it, making it useful as a lightweight connectivity or node-readiness check before performing certificate operations. The node must be reachable by PDM; offline or unreachable nodes will return an error.

examples.summary: List certificate sub-resources for a PDM node

tips: This is a directory index endpoint — it enumerates sub-resources under /nodes/{node}/certificates rather than returning certificate details directly; follow up with a more specific endpoint (e.g. get_nodes_node_certificates_info) to retrieve actual certificate data.
Accessible to all authenticated users (permissions: user=all), so no special privilege is needed, but API token access is supported if you prefer token-based auth.
